text:
Sara (Sales): heads up — UnifiedHealth pilot kickoff tomorrow. CISO wants a one-page risk matrix + status on blockers before the exec sync. can we pull together?

Mike (SE): copying the checklist I ran last week. Main open items: 1) BYO KMS attestation, 2) allowlist/ip peering, 3) SSO (SAML) prod test, 4) sustained throughput numbers for their 10k monthly active users.

Carla (CSM): timeline: security questionnaire due EOD Fri, legal wants DPA redlines by next Tue. Customer expects a live POC in 3 weeks.

Nina (Security): I can take the questionnaire. quick Q: are they asking for host-based logging export or just audit events? their note says "complete traceability for PHI flows".

Mike (SE): they want both. audit events + ability to stream logs to their SIEM. For POC we can provide audit via our console; streaming will need an engineering runbook.

Ash (Eng): streaming logs -> we can enable S3 delivery or Kinesis. delivery SLA isn't in scope for POC unless we schedule an infra task. estimated ~3 dev-days to wire up and test.

Oliver (Legal): on DPA — they have a special clause around data residency + subprocessors. we can accept residency in region eu-west-1 for the pilot, but subprocessors section needs manual approval. tagging @sara (Sales) for commercial impact.

Sara (Sales): thanks. can someone assemble a concise risk matrix (1 slide) with status: Residual risk, Owner, ETA? I can add commercial notes.

Mike (SE): I'll draft the matrix. starting status:
- KMS BYO: blocker (awaiting attestation doc from customer) — owner: Oliver/Nina — ETA: Tue next week
- IP allowlist & peering: partial (customer provided ranges) — owner: Ash — ETA: 48h for test
- SAML SSO test: ready in staging — owner: Carla/Mike — ETA: 2 days
- Throughput validation: needs perf report from runtime — owner: Ash — ETA: 4 days

Nina (Security): KMS attestation — ask the customer to provide their HSM cert + key rotation policy. if they can't share certs, we need a FedRAMP-style attestation letter. I put a short template below they can fill: 

```
We confirm that the customer-managed KMS (vendor: AcmeKMS) for UnifiedHealth pilot is configured with HSM-backed keys, AES-256, and rotates keys every 90 days. Audit logs are retained for 365 days and available to Redwood via secure export on request.
```

Carla (CSM): I'll send the template to their security contact this morning.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `staging/enable-saml-test` -> succeeded (run 2025-06-11T09:12:03Z).

Ash (Eng): quick note on throughput: our dedicated pool perf for the model family they picked (redwood-gpt-3.4-q4) shows 120 tokens/s per GPU in our test harness at seq_len=512. For 10k MAUs with avg 120 tokens/session that's ~1.2B tokens/month — we should recommend a reserved capacity plan. I'll attach a short calc after lunch.

Sara (Sales): perfect. Oliver — for the subprocessors clause, if we propose the standard limited subprocessor list + option to notify customers 30 days before changes, is that acceptable?

Oliver (Legal): likely yes, but we need to push back on unlimited liability. I'll draft a narrow redline and share in this thread.

Mike (SE): action items summary: 1) Mike will produce 1-slide risk matrix (ETA: today EOD). 2) Nina will prep sec questionnaire answers + KMS template (ETA: tomorrow). 3) Ash will run perf calc + test peering (ETA: 48h). 4) Oliver will start DPA redlines (ETA: Tue). 5) Carla will coordinate customer and collect attestation (ETA: today).

Carla (CSM): noted — I'll get the attestation and confirm the IP ranges. pinging customer: @unifiedhealth-sec (in external thread).

Sara (Sales): thanks team. I'll compile and send to UnifiedHealth before the exec sync. if any major blockers surface, @here ping me. :thumbsup:

Nina (Security): one more risk: PHI tokenization plan. need confirmation whether customer wants tokenization on ingest or within their environment. that affects whether we need additional encryption-at-rest controls.

Mike (SE): I'll add that to the matrix.

Ash (Eng): FYI — if they require in-transit mTLS for peering, we need to schedule cert prep. call with infra ops recommended.

Oliver (Legal): uploaded initial DPA redline to the shared drive: https://redwood.app/drive/unifiedhealth/dpa-redline-v1 (please review).

Sara (Sales): reading now. if everyone can react with :eyes: when reviewed, I will move to send.

Carla (CSM): :eyes:

Mike (SE): :eyes:

Nina (Security): :eyes:

Ash (Eng): :eyes:

Oliver (Legal): thanks — will iterate.

Sara (Sales): awesome. closing loop — will post final 1-pager here after EOD.
